name: Manoj Kumar Tudu
title: Software Developer, Manager
tagline: Backend Engineering · System Design · CI/CD · AI Agents
summary: Software Developer, Manager with 4+ years in backend engineering, system design, CI/CD, and production support. At Waaree Autonova, lead 3 engineers on a Warehouse Management System (WMS) and Supplier Front. Delivered a live inventory and analysis portal used by 200+ users across the organization, with full traceability of raw material and finished goods. Reports that took 2–3 hours — and some a full day plus PPT dashboards — are now real time. Built in a short cycle using AI agents. At Genpact, Python/Flask APIs and Harness CI/CD cut query time 50%, release cycle 25%, and deployment time 40%.

highlights: Lead a team of 3 engineers on WMS and Supplier Front, from client requirements through development, deployment, and production support.
Work directly with clients to capture warehouse and sourcing workflows, then translate them into scalable data flows, APIs, database operations, and integrations.
Own end-to-end delivery across development, testing, deployment, and production validation, and resolve real-time production issues to keep warehouse and dispatch operations running.
Built a live inventory and analysis portal used by 200+ users across the organization with full traceability of raw material and finished goods.
Reports that took 2–3 hours, and some that took a full day, are now real time. Delivered in a short cycle using AI agents.
Warehouse Management System (WMS) for raw materials and finished goods: material tracking, shop-floor scanning, warehouse visibility, RM outward workflows, and QR-based digitization.
Supplier Front sources material from both offshore and domestic suppliers. Suppliers submit bids on the portal for reverse auctions (RA) and RFQs.
Developed and maintained ~15 backend APIs using Python/Flask, with PostgreSQL data operations and integrations.
Built applications using Python, Django, React, and SQL, improving database query response time by 50%.
Designed a React/Python release-management portal and automated deployments with Harness IDP and CI/CD, reducing the release cycle by 25% and deployment time by 40%.
Led incident management that reduced system outages by 30% in the first quarter, exceeding a 15% annual target.
Identified infrastructure and workflow bottlenecks through large-scale log and data analysis, improving system efficiency by 45%.
